propositions: close_precheck derives code_root from os.path.dirname(tracker) instead of the current worktree, causing git log and completion-gate config to scan the wrong repository when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is out-of-worktree

With a relocated tracker and a valid commit trailer in the code worktree, CLI rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no referencing commit because git -C runs against the tracker parent instead of the code root
code_root must be resolved through config.repo_root(repo_root) to reflect the explicit/current repository context, while ticket state continues to resolve through config.tracker_dir independently
The defect cascades to completion-gate configuration and autoresume repo_root, both of which must use the correct code root rather than the tracker parent
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit failures must remain unchanged after the repair
